title: MCU spontaneous restart: clean shutdown instead of an error in the shutdown code (Klipper 9ce631e8)

edits:
def invoke_async_shutdown(self, msg, details):
    def invoke_async_shutdown(self, msg, details={}):

note: mcu.py calls invoke_async_shutdown() with one argument when an MCU restarts on its own (e.g. a QIDI Box or the toolhead board losing power); 02.04's signature requires two, so the shutdown itself failed with a TypeError. Upstream fix by Kevin O'Connor (2024-12-02).
